channel.title: Kamlesh Bhagatkar: articles
channel.description: Geopolitics and current affairs from Nagpur, by politician, author and geopolitical analyst Kamlesh Bhagatkar.

item.title: Japan Will Train at Indian Firing Ranges. What the Tokyo 2+2 Settled
item.description: India and Japan signed a Letter of Intent for Japanese forces to train at Indian firing ranges, and named economic coercion as a shared worry.

item.title: Made-in-India Shipping Containers: Can ₹10,000 Crore Loosen China's Hold?
item.description: India's ₹10,000 crore container manufacturing scheme pays makers per box and aims for 7.5 lakh TEUs a year. The test is the price gap with China.

item.title: EPFO Approves Monthly PF Payouts and Cuts the Minimum Balance to 10%
item.description: The EPFO board approved a Systematic Withdrawal Plan for retirees, a 10% minimum PF balance and a two-month wait for final withdrawal.

item.title: World Bank on India's Poverty: 27% to 2.6%, and the Work Still Ahead
item.description: The World Bank says extreme poverty in India fell from 27.1% to 2.6% between 2011 and 2023. Here is what the figures show and what they leave open.

item.title: The India Japan 2+2 in Tokyo: Test Ranges, Warships and Trust
item.description: Rajnath Singh and S Jaishankar meet their Japanese counterparts in Tokyo today. Missile test ranges, joint shipbuilding and a stealth antenna are on the table.

item.title: The Quad Summit in Manila: Patrol Planes, Sea Cables and a Forum for India
item.description: Quad leaders met in Manila after a gap of two years. They agreed on joint maritime surveillance, energy cables and a business forum India wants to host.

item.title: Why Rubio Went to Jamnagar: India's Oil Refining Power and What It Buys Us
item.description: India is the world's fourth-largest refining nation. Washington pressed us over Russian oil, then sent its top diplomat to Jamnagar. Refining capacity explains the gap.

item.title: SIM Binding for WhatsApp and Telegram: What Changes on 1 January
item.description: From 1 January 2027, messaging apps in India must stay tied to the SIM in your phone. Why the government wants it, and what it costs.

item.title: India and Egypt Agree to Explore a Trade Pact. The $12 Billion Test
item.description: India and Egypt will study a preferential or free trade agreement. Trade is recovering, but an old $12 billion target is still out of reach.

item.title: India and Somalia Hold Their First Foreign Office Talks. Why It Matters at Sea
item.description: India and Somalia have opened a formal dialogue in Mogadishu, with piracy high on the agenda. Here is what it means for our sea lanes.

item.title: China Curbs Tunnel Boring Machine Exports. India Must Make Its Own
item.description: From 18 November, China needs a licence to ship tunnel boring machines to "sensitive" countries. Here is what that means for India's tunnels and how we respond.

item.title: Qatar and Türkiye Sign a Defence Pact. What It Means for Bharat
item.description: Qatar, India's largest gas supplier, has signed a mutual defence pact with Türkiye, which is already bound to Pakistan by treaty. Here is what to watch.

item.title: Modi Goes to Manila: Trade, Myanmar and an Unconfirmed Quad
item.description: Modi attends the ASEAN-India and East Asia summits in Manila from 16 November. A Quad meeting is likely but unconfirmed. Trade is the harder test.

item.title: Jaishankar Says the China Border Is "More Alive". He Is Right
item.description: Jaishankar says the China border now needs a much larger standing troop presence. The Arunachal face-offs show why the thaw has not changed the ground.

item.title: Goyal Promises "One of the Best" US Trade Deals. Here Is the Test
item.description: Piyush Goyal says India will get one of the best US trade deals. The real test is how our tariff compares with Vietnam's and Bangladesh's.

item.title: A Trump-Xi-Putin Meeting in Shenzhen? What Bharat Should Watch
item.description: Washington says peace and denuclearisation could come up at a possible US-China-Russia leaders' meeting next week. India will not be at that table.

item.title: India's Black Sea Ideas: A Practical Offer in the Ukraine War
item.description: After Modi spoke to Zelenskyy and Jaishankar to Lavrov, New Delhi says it has shared ideas on Black Sea shipping, grain and energy.

item.title: Hormuz Is Burning, and India's Oil Still Flows. Here Is Why
item.description: As tankers burn in the Strait of Hormuz, Indian Oil's numbers show how India spread its risk: 55 per cent Russian crude and fuller stocks.

item.title: India and the EU Clear the Desk Before Brussels
item.description: The 7th India-EU review in New Delhi shows what is settled before the December trade deal signing, and what still is not.

item.title: Watching the World from the Centre of India
item.description: Why geopolitics matters to anyone who runs a business, buys petrol or has a child in the army.

item.title: Nineteen Days: What Operation Sindoor Changed for India
item.description: Terror now has an address and a price. Four lessons from the nineteen days between Pahalgam and the ceasefire.

item.title: A Hundred Years of Sewa: What I Learnt Writing About the RSS
item.description: How an organisation with no salaries and no glamour kept going for a century.
